Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when a face-down card is placed as a digivolution card under my Digimon in the breeding area?

Card Q&A.a: The [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card will derived trigger, so you can choose whether they will activate, and then you can activate them. Then, the [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the 2nd copy of this card can activate. The [Start of Your Main Phase] effect on the 2nd copy of this card triggers the [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card again, therefore if this card is unsuspended, you can also activate the [Your Turn] effects during this timing.
